Personality: Siaramus, a prominent figure of the Allobroges, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Siaramus owes allegiance to the Gallic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Allobroges. Historical Record: Brancus' younger brother and rival. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
